name: htl
description: Human in the loop: Claude hands you a job it truly cannot do (a 2FA login, a missing secret, a physical step, a payment), you answer in a pane, and Claude carries on.

secrets.title: Where your secrets live
secrets.description: 1password: Claude uses secrets through op:// references with op run or op inject, and asks you only for a secret that is not in 1Password yet. none: no secret manager.
